title: Quantum gate lower bounds for loss-tolerant position verification
summary: Quantum position-verification is a cryptographic task wherein a verifier attempts to establish the location in space of a prover. Recent experiments have implemented a well-studied class of position-verification schemes, known as the $f$-BB84 scenario, but their security under realistic loss and imperfect state preparation remains incompletely understood.
